context_policy: Short tasks use the same practical 32768 reservation; long-context tasks are separate. Exact actual prompt counts and generation headroom must be verified per family.
mode_policy: Off and family-specific Low enabled, verified by the actual renderer/backend and live usage. Identical effort strings do not imply equivalent behavior.
reasoning_budget_policy: Preserve and document each backend's existing answer-room policy in the primary practical cohort. Native Strata normally closes thinking near1536 of2048; current Maya thinking_budget0 is uncapped within the total. Neither is described as an identical thinking allocation. Consider a separately labelled budget-policy intervention only if the primary results show it changes the practical conclusion.
larger_budget_policy: If truncation limits conclusions, use a separate complete frozen MMLU-Pro64 cohort at4096 for relevant stable enabled candidates. Never selectively replace failed primary attempts.
seed_policy: The pinned Responses implementations do not expose a seed parameter. Use explicit greedy sampling and document that bitwise hardware determinism is not guaranteed.
endpoint_policy: Read-only verify exact already-loaded Control-owned active-only model; POST Responses only to its backend. No client loads, switches, configures or restarts engines.
count_policy: Responses uses the same Service/template path as Chat and exposes provider reasoning-token counts. Confirm parity offline and with small live probes before the main cohort. Total output allowance includes reasoning; non-reasoning generated tokens may include control markers.
timing_policy: Downloads complete or freshly acknowledged paused. No competing GPU workload. Retain first observed output of any kind, first visible final-answer text, terminal completed-answer arrival and transport wall separately.
deadline_policy: Grade completed final answers retrospectively at30,60,120seconds. Incomplete, truncated, wrong or absent answers are not timed successes, regardless of intermediate text.
attempt_policy: One request per question per reported condition; no automatic inference retries. Persist every attempt and allow only metadata recovery. Functionality screen results are retained within the same condition rather than rerun.
practical_scoring: Report public128 and practical24 separately. Separate strict formatting, answer-content correctness, code execution, completed-generation status, truncation and repetition.
memory_and_gpu_policy: Auto GPU inventory, layer placement and RAM budgets. Preserve production memory guards. GLM may retain the previously tested750MiB experimental VRAM reserve, explicitly scoped and recorded; native Flash uses its hardware planner's Auto reserve. Record all requested and actual allocations, never assume they match.
long_context_policy: Common frozen approximately20k/80k/120k evidence tasks: distributed retrieval, multi-passage combination, contradictions and missing evidence. Grade complete final answers separately from short reasoning. Account for tokenizer differences and reserve generation room.
speed_policy: Reuse completed representative evidence. Add only missing short/80k warmup plus three-repeat measurements initially. S24/190k expansion requires a quality justification.
upgrade_policy: First assess native Linux feasibility without installation/repartitioning; benefits remain unproven. Price complete used128–256GB options retaining both cards/NVMe, recording delivered cost, compatibility, power/fit and resale assumptions. No unjustified SSD/expensive GPU recommendation.
cleanup: Unload through Control, verify owned process exit and endpoint closure, restore temporary overrides, keep desktop-only.json enabled, and do not automatically load another model.
